prompt:
Edit the reference picture. Keep everything exactly as it is: the same woman, the same face, freckles and
dark blonde hair pulled back, the same grey-blue cardigan and white blouse, the same pose with her forearms
on the light wooden table and her hands lying one over the other, the same seminar room, the same window on
the right and the same daylight, the same framing and the same distance. Change only her expression: she
gives a warm, open, genuine smile, her lips parted just enough to show a little of her upper teeth, her
cheeks lifted and her eyes smiling, as a kind examiner who is glad to see the candidate. She keeps looking
straight into the lens.

The textures of real wool, cotton, wood, skin and painted plaster, as a visitor would take it with a good
phone camera.
